_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture and distribution of healthcare products, including innovative medicines and vaccines' (FY2019 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'Certain of our current products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'

classification.quality_note: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture and distribution of healthcare products, including innovative medicines and vaccines' (FY2019 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for our branded products around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues' (Item 1A); 'Certain of our current products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face significantly increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.63x; -20% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.13; conservative 2yr +57%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -47.2%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.0%/yr (FY20 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.7%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +78.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2021-01-15) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.63x (78.2% downside to Bear $8 / +123.4% upside to Bull $82) | Adj composite 1.88 vs market 1.75: gap +0.13 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -20% above the EPP floor $46 (16x FY20E $2.87) | Conservative 2-yr case: +57.1% total (+28.6%/yr) | At 12.8x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $49 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues -2.3% in Q3 2020, forward revenues -5.7% to -4.3% (FY20 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
